result.summary:
CODE-DESIGNER, WF-03 step 2 round 3 for ISS-0002. Design only: the one project file changed is docs/design/REQ-002-idea-verdict.md (version 4, round 3). docs/requirements.yaml (sha256 4450091a...), tools/src and tools/test (23 files, equal to ORCH's pre-fix manifest) and every other file are untouched. Next: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR re-check of the sections listed in changes.

ALL EIGHT FINDINGS FIXED, as ORCH ruled (F1 as ruled; F2-F8 as proposed).
- F1 (blocking): the read-through of a symlinked run folder is now stated in 5.4 (new table row), in 11 (new bullet), and in the Q11 rows of 10 and 12. Wording: validate and the read phase of apply-verdict follow a symlinked runs/<RUN-ID> (or runs); they only read; nothing is written outside <root> (W1.1; W13, W13b); cli.js and validate.js do not change; ORCH accepted it on 2026-10-01; decisions/0004 will record it together with the write strategy. No new test, per ORCH. The row's 'before' column is my own evidence on the pre-fix copy: validate exits 0 with 'OK WF06-20260925-01 (stage review)' through a link to a run outside <root>.
- F2: 9.2 now says tree() returns one string, lines joined with newline, extra optional, so apply.reject, apply.state, apply.accept and cli.test.js need no edit (I grepped all callers: four files, all assert.equal on strings).
- F3: 9.2 now says the existing chmod tests restore the mode they read before the chmod. I ran it instead of reading it: under umask 077 the fixture file is 0600 and restoring the literal 0o644 gives 0644, so a strict listing that records modes would differ; under umask 022 it is equal.
- F4: I dropped the label field from this change (the validator's first option). Nothing in this change calls it and no test row covers it. 5.7 now says targets are { rel, content } inside root only; 5.6 'Для ISS-0003' says the out-of-root file-name rule and the helper extension are ISS-0003's, with its own test.
- F5: 5.5, 7 and 12 (R2) now say that snapshot lists only files, so a leftover file and a temp folder with a file in it show up in snapshot-diff and an empty temp folder does not (the command's own leftover check, W1.3/P1, still refuses it). Verified on the real snapshot.js: .STATE.md.sai-tmp, .STATE.md.sai-old and a file inside a temp folder are listed; an empty runs/.X.sai-tmp and an empty .runs.sai-tmp are not.
- F6: 5.2 and 5.3 (W3) now say 'if STATE.md is among the replaced targets, it is replaced last'. A skipped STATE.md (already equal, W1.5) takes no part; an interrupted run then adds no new inconsistency, because the same one existed before it. If STATE.md is not replaced, the commit point is the last rename of the replaced targets.
- F7: 9.4 has a rule before the table. Rows with 'A5 заменяется' compare entries added or replaced by the run by type, mode, size and sha256, without mtime; a .sai-old hard link is compared in every field, mtime too, with the old file's line in the 'before' listing; every other entry must equal the 'before' listing in full. Rows W44, W45, W46 and P11 point to it.
- F8: new row W13b (runs is a link to a folder outside <root> that holds the run): two E_WRITE lines naming 'folder runs'. New mutant M19 (W1.1 checks only runs/<RUN-ID>) is killed by W13b; M7 now names W13b too. Pre-fix result of W13b, which I ran: exit 0, STATE.md changed, proposed-actions.json and apply-report.json written outside <root>, runs still a link.

THINGS I FOUND WHILE FIXING (beyond the findings; all small, all done)
- W38 has the same unpredictable-mtime problem as W44-W46 (a 'foreign' temp file created during the run), so the F7 rule covers W38 too.
- The injection's 'partial' effect did not define 'half'. 9.2 now says the first floor(n/2) characters of the string, so the expected size and sha256 in W44 and P11 can be computed. This matters because the fixture text is Cyrillic: a byte half and a character half differ.
- 5.7's row for snapshot.js had the same imprecise wording as F5 ('leftovers are regular files, visible'); fixed.
- 5.6's first paragraph named out-of-root files without saying that this change has none; it is marked as ISS-0003's rule.
- 12 (Q3) lists the round-3 probes; the header's outdated sentence 'CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR has not checked version 4' now records the round-2 FAIL and the round-3 note (the validator asked for this).

OPEN POINTS FOR ORCH
1. Criterion 11's last sentence ('если в STATE.md уже новое содержимое, то и в остальных целях тоже') has the same corner as F6 when STATE.md is already equal to the new text and is skipped. Read as 'when the run replaces STATE.md' it is true; the design says so in 5.2 and in the 9.1 row. I did not touch docs/requirements.yaml.
2. 5.6 is named by F4 but not in the validator's list of sections to re-check; it is listed in changes.
3. The optional 'fixation' row for validate on a symlinked run folder was not added (your ruling). The accepted behaviour is written in 5.4 and 11, not tested.
4. decisions/0004 (write strategy, read-through acceptance) is still to be written by ORCH before implementation; the design cites the number as ORCH named it.
5. Still open from earlier rounds: ISS-0003's text (its cases a and e are closed here); WF-06 and verdict-executor.md say nothing about E_WRITE or leftovers; TEST-DESIGNER and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR must be on the route.
